title: When the Coupon Moves with ESG
subtitle: Eurofiber’s €2.2 billion Sustainability-Linked Loan and the CFO choice between a use-of-proceeds green loan and a margin ratchet
description: HBS-style teaching case on Eurofiber’s 25 August 2026 refinancing: a €2.2 billion Sustainability-Linked Loan replacing a 2022 €1.5 billion facility, with a margin-adjustment mechanism tied to SBTi-aligned Scope 1–3 emissions, a newly introduced circularity KPI, and workforce gender diversity. Students decide whether a future CFO should take the ratchet, narrow it to emissions, insist on a green loan, or stay with conventional debt.
